what: A row of product and book cards sticks out past the right (and left) of the panel and loops endlessly, advancing one card every 3 seconds in .3s (Swiper 8 loop). On wide screens CSS sets the card width (1/3 of the panel width − 100px, minus 12px, 18px gap) so the next card peeks in at the panel edge. 640~839px shows three cards, and below that 1.13 cards (20px gap). Using the round prev/next buttons or dragging doesn’t stop autoplay, and the next timer keeps running during a transition

options.delay: Time to the next slot (ms), default 3000 — 0 keeps it flowing without pause (give a long speed for a marquee-like effect)
options.speed: Duration of one step shift (ms), default 300
options.auto: If off, no auto-advance, buttons and drag only
options.per: Wide-screen column count, default auto (column width is --fx-slide)
options.gap: Wide screen gap between cells (px, Swiper spaceBetween), default 0 — when auto, the gap is css --fx-gap (default 18px)
options.gap-narrow: Gap between columns on medium and narrow screens (px), default 20
options.wide: Window width on wide screens (px), default 840
options.mid: Window width (px) for medium view, default 640
options.--fx-slide · --fx-gap: Cell width and gap on wide screens (via style), default calc((100% - 100px) / 3 - 12px) · 18px
options.--fx-nav-top · --fx-prev-x · --fx-next-x: Previous/next button position (via style), default 33% · -25px · 75px (-14px on both sides on narrow screens)
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Swiper panel (.swiper > .swiper-wrapper > .swiper-slide) — not needed if the element itself is .swiper

note: Because the panel’s overflow is released so cells show outside the panel, overflow-x: hidden is set on the page wrapper (original .page_wrap). The slide curve is the Swiper default (css ease-out)
